summary: Close-up of the guest tucking his napkin into his collar while he says he expected a different dish.
framing: Close-up, eye level, of the guest in 3/4 right profile, head and shoulders; static camera. Plain blue wall, an ornate green oval frame with pink flowers behind the back of his head at upper left, top corner of a dark red chair at lower right.

cast.costume: navy suit, white napkin tucked into the collar as a bib

props: white cloth napkin hanging from the guest's collar
green ornate oval frame with pink flowers on the wall
red chair-back corner at lower right

beats.action: head 3/4 right, chin level, eyes lowered looking down-right (toward the platter), upper lids heavy, brows flat; right hand (screen left) at his collar pushing the top of the napkin in, mouth closed
starts speaking; hand keeps working the napkin at the collar with small up-down pushes
hand lets go and drops from the collar; lips pursed forward
hand at the bottom edge of frame, leaving; lids half-closed
hand out of frame; eyes fully closed (blink)
lids half-open, pupils now to the right
eyes open, looking straight to screen-right at the host, brows low and level, teeth clenched; head unchanged
head tips back and up a little, chin raised; eyes look up-right, inner brows pulled down into a doubtful frown; held while speaking
small head nod forward on the stressed word, then back
head settles back to level, mouth closes, eyes heavy-lidded looking right; holds with only the mouth moving

notes: Camera static, agrees with timeline.json. On twos, new drawings on odd frames. script.json puts the first word of L25 at 1785; the mouth is already slightly open from the 1779 drawing and wide by 1783. The line continues over the cut into S24. The frame-with-flowers behind his head does not match the background of S25/S27 (different wall dressing in the same seat).
